author: kirbymaster21
quote: This "one-by-one" [remake/re-release] was a total cash grab and pure nostalgia bait. They took the original game—which wasn't even good to begin with—and made it even worse. The game is a bore; instead of focusing on graphics, they should have given it some soul. A waste of time and money. I wouldn't recommend it—it’s overrated.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: kirbymaster21
quote: I played it after the remake, and it’s old—it’s unplayable. Even so, it’s still better than the remake; by the standards of the time, it wasn’t good at all. But it was an attempt at something that just went wrong.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: kirbymaster21
quote: An incomparable game; the 13-year wait was truly worth it—quite simply the best thing many will ever get to experience. We are witnessing history! I highly recommend it!
